items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [They identify Melba and Buddy Redd.] Elvira – Vi Redd’s brother.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. His mother and my mother used to be friends. [They fail to identify another trumpeter in the photo.]
[They identify Melba and Buddy Redd.] Elvira – Vi Redd’s brother. Do you know about when this was?
